source.notes: No official marking scheme is published with this paper; questions carry no official answer. From the CISCE Archive Library ISC 2020 question-paper bundle (a Word-generated PDF with a real text layer). Paper code '1220-860' printed in the footer of every page. Cover: '(Maximum Marks: 100)', '(Time allowed: Three hours)', additional 15 minutes reading time, 6 printed pages. Section A (80 marks) is compulsory; candidates attempt all questions EITHER from Section B (vectors, 3-D geometry, area; 20 marks) OR Section C (commerce/economics applications, regression, linear programming; 20 marks). Both Sections B and C are included, so the pack's marks total (120 counting one alternative per OR pair) exceeds maxMarks (100) by design. Question 1 is printed '[10×2]' (ten sub-parts of 2 marks each) and Questions 15 and 19 '[3×2]'; each sub-part is its own entry. OR choices (Q3, 7, 8, 12, 13, 16, 17, 20, 21) share a choiceGroup equal to the question number; alternatives labelled (a)/(b) as printed. Notation: powers are smaller raised glyphs that pdftotext flattens (checked with pdfplumber); equation-editor content (determinants, matrices, stacked fractions, integral limits, inverse-trig arguments, the limit in Q7(b)) is scrambled in the text layer and was rebuilt inline from page renders, flagged MEDIUM. Minus signs in several coordinates extract as a combining strike-through character (e.g. '(3,̶ 1, 2)'); restored as '−'. Some topics reflect the 2020 syllabus: Q1(i) binary operation (mapped to relations-and-functions), Q7(b) L'Hospital's rule (mapped to continuity-differentiability-and-differentiation). Regression items and the break-even item Q19(a) have no matching chapter slug and are left with chapter null. No cognitive-level tags are printed on this paper.
